contributes.configuration.properties.uns: Base URL of the Unsloth API (default port 8888)
API key (sk-unsloth-...), created in Unsloth: Settings > API
Model name
System prompt
Temperature
Maximum response length in tokens
Top-P (empty = Unsloth default)
Top-K (empty = Unsloth default)
Min-P (empty = Unsloth default)
Repeat penalty (empty = Unsloth default)
Seed (empty = Unsloth default)
Reasoning effort (empty = default)
Enable server-side Unsloth tools
Tool: Python execution
Tool: web search
Tool: terminal/bash
Context length in tokens for "unsloth run" (passed as -c, empty = Unsloth default)
How the currently open file is attached to a message: content = full file content, reference = only path, cursor line and selection (the model reads the file itself via tools, e.g. MCP filesystem)

Automatically trim chat history when it does not fit the context: auto = upfront based on the token budget and additionally on "context too large" errors, onError = only after that error (with retry), off = never trim
Token budget for upfront trimming (empty = contextLength or the context size reported by the server)
Number of most recent turns (question + answer/tool calls) that are never removed when trimming
Download directory for models started via "unsloth run" (sets HF_HOME and HF_HUB_CACHE=<dir>\hub in the terminal). Empty = default (%USERPROFILE%\.cache\huggingface).
Additional flags for "unsloth run" (e.g. -c 131072 --threads 8)
Permission for Unsloth tools: off = no prompts, full = no prompts and no sandbox, auto = prompt only for risky calls, ask = prompt for every call (confirmation via dialog in VS Code)
contributes.commands.3.title: Unsloth Chat: Restart MCP servers
contributes.configuration.properties.uns: MCP servers whose tools the chat can use (client-side), e.g. {"desktop-commander": {"command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@wonderwhy-er/desktop-commander@latest"]}}. For WSL use "wsl.exe" as command.
Ask for confirmation in the chat before MCP tool calls (only in permission modes "ask" and "auto"; "off" and "full" never ask)
Run this server inside WSL (true = default distribution, or a distribution name such as "Streetbuzz"). Only has an effect when VS Code runs on Windows.
Working directory (inside WSL if "wsl" is set, e.g. /home/user/project)
Only use these tools of the server (names, wildcard * allowed)
Do not use these tools of the server (names, wildcard * allowed)
Max. length of tool descriptions for this server (overrides unslothChat.mcpDescMaxLength, 0 = unlimited)

Maximum length of MCP tool descriptions in characters (0 = unlimited). Longer descriptions help the model but cost context. Can be overridden per server with "descMaxLength"; filter tools per server with "includeTools"/"excludeTools" (wildcard *).
When MCP tools are available, do not use Unsloth's built-in sandbox tools (python, terminal, web search) so the model uses the MCP tools
System hint for MCP tools. Empty = built-in default text. Placeholders: {0} = server list, {1} = addition (see mcpHintExclusive).
Addition to the MCP hint when mcpExclusive is on (placeholder {1}). Empty = built-in default text.
